# Revel Nail Dip Powder Starter Kit: Salon-Style Nails at Home

Get long, polished nails without the salon appointment. The Revel Nail Dip Powder Starter Kit includes everything you need to start dip manicures at home, plus 15 ml (0.5 oz) of Step #1 Probase to build your base.

## Simple Application, Fewer Steps

Dip powder uses thin layers of liquid glue and powder instead of lamp-cured gel, so you skip the curing time between coats. Each layer goes on evenly, and you finish by buffing and clearing the surface.

## Benefits for Your Nails and Routine

- **Added strength for longer nails:** The powder system adds structure to natural nails, helping them resist bending, peeling, and breaking as they grow.
- **Faster manicures:** Without repeated curing, you spend less time at each session.
- **Lasting wear:** Many users find their manicures hold up well between touch-ups.
- **Salon-quality results at home:** Achieve a polished look on your own schedule.

## Approachable for Beginners and Experienced DIYers

Clear instructions make the process easy to learn, and the efficient workflow suits people who already enjoy doing their own nails.

## Ready to Start Your Next Manicure?

Add the Revel Nail Dip Powder Starter Kit to your cart and create strong, beautiful nails from your own home.
